title: seqoutRun
description: Custom run schema. Source metadata has no performed-date, so the default model's required runDate is dropped; release dates are carried in info.releaseDate + info.dateSource. biosampleId is optional because GSA runs have no ontology-backed biosample to reference.

biosampleId.description: Sample accession; present only when resolvable in /biosamples (omitted for GSA).

info.description: Non-model extras; releaseDate + dateSource live here.
